featured_reviews.name: Kiran
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this to warn potential buyers about the unethical practices at Kohinoor Eden. My experience has been mentally harassing due to their complete lack of transparency.
​Hidden Charges & Extra Demands: At the time of booking, we were given a 'final' cost sheet. Now, they are demanding extra money for basic necessities like the water connection and clubhouse membership, which were implied to be part of the package.
​Blueprint Changes: They changed the project blueprint without informing the buyers. The layout I booked is not what is being delivered, and they made these critical structural changes without any prior consent.
​One-Sided Agreement: When I questioned these changes, they pointed to their builder-buyer agreement. It is completely one-sided and drafted to protect only them, leaving the buyer with zero rights.
​Poor Quality & Congestion: The construction quality is extremely poor compared to the sample flat. On top of that, the project layout is incredibly congested; it feels like a concrete jungle with barely any open space.
​They lure you in with marketing, but once you sign, they squeeze you for money and deliver a substandard product. Avoid at all costs

featured_reviews.name: Gung Ho
featured_reviews.review_text:
A. I had given a very positive review earlier. But revising it based on last two years experience now.
1. The location is great.
2. The mono rail track is just outside the building at a tangent.
3. Tower A has the massive Bus depot land in front which hopefully will stay and therefore there may not be too much obstruction in front side in near future.

B And now the negatives :

1. The tower at the back (Tower C) is too    close to the SRA building. It is very discomforting, to say the least.
2. The progress in the project is painfully slow.  Even after over two years, the project has not even reached above ground. For tower C the four levels of basement are nearing completion, for tower B three levels of Basement are nearing completion and for tower A only excavation and piling work is done. It is shocking that the Runwal Management is not concerned about this. As long as RERA timelines are met, such delays do not seem to bother the company.
3. The company does not send any updates about the progress and this has to be ascertained from the CRM team from time to time. Even they are reluctant to share details, out of fear that they may disclose something that causes a reputational risk. Very difficult to get information from the team.
While Sidha Sky and Dosti Eastern Bay (both more or less contemporary projects) have completed a few of the towers and will be shortly looking to give possession.

C. The builder needs to do two things to inspire confidence :
1. Expedite completion of the project. Ivan technology is the fastest available and such delays are neither understood nor appreciated.
2. Share the reasons for delay and the progress made on a monthly basis with the buyers.

I hope the Runwal timeless team will take this in the right spirit and take constructive steps to rectify the situation.

featured_reviews.review_text: Do not fall prey to this developer’s marketing gimmicks! Save your hard-earned money—he gives zero regard for his customers and their rights. Despite a clear clause stating the builder would bear the Government liability, he refused to pay and forced members to bear the entire liability withholding possession without rent until we paid him. We had to pay money to get our own flats back. Have you ever seen this in a redevlopment project? This was a huge burden on us. You really do no want to risk crores of your hard earned money with a party that doesnt care about your rights, legal obligations or Government liabilities. featured_reviews.name: Esmail Beguwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Undoubtedly it is the most value for money project in the locality where it is based. I have booked a 2 BHK in tower 2B. The pace of construction was fast as far as the structural framework was being erected with 3 floors added every month.
But now the tiling and flooring work has been very slow paced, perhaps since the labour force is limited and they are focusing on Tower 1A to meet the December 2025 RERA timeline. The CRM says they are running as per schedule and are committed to delivering 2B by December 2026 and I'm hoping for 2B work pace to be increased again.
As of now towers 1A, 1B and 2B haven't been assigned official names like Altaire and Celestia towers have.
As for the locality, slowly all slums are being converted to resedential complexes and the general Outlook of the area is improving so the property appreciation is expected to be good.
